name: youtube-transcript-summarizer
description: Chrome extension to summarize YouTube transcripts

scripts.watch:js: parcel watch src/background/service_worker.js src/content_scripts/youtube_transcript_fetcher.js src/content_scripts/chatgpt_interactor.js src/utils/transcript_chunker.js src/utils/indexeddb_helper.js --out-dir dist --public-url ./ --no-source-maps
scripts.build:js: parcel build src/background/service_worker.js src/content_scripts/youtube_transcript_fetcher.js src/content_scripts/chatgpt_interactor.js src/utils/transcript_chunker.js src/utils/indexeddb_helper.js --out-dir dist --public-url ./ --no-source-maps
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:js && npm run copy:assets
scripts.copy:assets: cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist/icons
